reviews.text: What an awesome team full of live and joy! Always clean and welcoming. Highly recommended
Great place, perfect location, the service was fantastic and my dog came out of there as a new little man! - thank you Sarah and the rest of the team 🙏🙏🙏 …

Excellent Grooming Experience

Sara did an amazing job grooming my dog, Milo! 🐾 He looks absolutely adorable, clean, and so well-groomed. Sara was wonderful with him and clearly took the time to make sure he was comfortable and well cared for.

I’m so happy with the results and will definitely be bringing Milo back to Sara again. Highly recommend her to anyone looking for a caring and talented groomer! ❤️🐶
Love the staff. I have 2 Schnauzers that are difficult to handle fir nail trimming.  They do an excellent job. Highly recommended them.
Tania was amazing with my nervous pup. The whole team is lovely and it’s obvious they care about their clients - animals and humans alike.

Tania is now officially our regular groomer, and we couldn’t be happier!
We recently had an emergency situation where Bentley desperately needed a groom, and Tania was incredibly accommodating, fitting him right into her schedule. He just got his summer cut and came out looking absolutely fantastic—and most importantly, he was so happy and relaxed!
What I love most is that Tania always takes the time to ask exactly what we want from a grooming perspective before she starts. Her communication is consistently top-notch, clear, and professional.
If you want a skilled groomer who truly cares about your pup and listens to your preferences, I highly recommend Tania!

Warning about this place. I have brought my dog in several times for grooming and the work is rushed and poorly done, but the last time i brought my dog in was the worse. Tanya butchered my dog. He was badly cut under his arm, the rest of the grooming was extremely poorly done as well. The worst part was she didn’t tell me that she cut him, and she knew. I had to take him to the vet and stitches were required. I will not go back here. Be careful.
